setup_logging: setup logging to stdout or a file for the main process in a distributed training run
get_logger: get a named logger instance from the standard logging module for use in pycls modules
dump_log_data: convert a dictionary of metrics into a tagged JSON string for logging with fixed precision floats
load_log_data: load and parse JSON log data from a log file into a nested dictionary by data type and metric
sort_log_data: sort loaded log data by epoch and iteration or keep only the first instance per metric
